description: This visual was developed in partnership with Hamed Behairy - CFA.... one of top financial trainers in the world Beeswarm chart shows the distribution of data along y axis while also showing individual points. It is like a one-dimensional scatter plot but with closely-packed, non-overlapping points. All functionalities of this visual are available for free within Power BI Desktop. In Power BI Online Service, it will show a watermark. To use the visual without watermark in Power BI Online, please purchase license subscription For more information visit https://www.excelnaccess.com/beeswarm-chart/ or contact zubair@excelnaccess.com Would love to get your feedback on this visual.
